headline: “Battery-First Power”: Inside Bibby Marine’s new eCSOV Vessel Design
description: As Bibby Marine’s new Eco Construction Service Operation Vessel (eCSOV) takes shape at Armon Shipyard in Vigo, Spain, Gavin Forward, Vessel Newbuild Director, Bibby Marine, discusses the unique vessel’s “battery-first power philosophy” that helps to deliver a long list of operational benefits, including a 40-60% reduction in Underwater Radiated Noise (URN).
